prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 84.1%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 78.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, redesign] Desktop Visibility & Rendering Diagnostic Wait Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a split view showing real-time desktop display permissions and pet rendering progress. (why: The waiting screen has a high median duration of 201s, and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop after setup.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Control & Floating Dock Setup Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding guide screen illustrating desktop pet controls, hotkeys, and hide/show toggles. (why: Support received multiple confusion tickets regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Personality Setup Tips During Waiting Screen: Add an interactive tip carousel and completion notification setup on the waiting screen while graphics load. (why: The waiting step mean time is 2336s; engaging users during generation prevents drop-offs.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence & Cloud Save Guarantee Hint: Display a helpful security hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that pet data is saved automatically. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in.)
4: [choose_path, notification] Estimated Onboarding Duration Notification Banner: Enable time estimates and step counter guidance on the path selection screen. (why: Choose path drops 20.9% of users with an 8s median / 514s mean time; clear time expectations increase confidence.)
